items.headline: Qualcomm's next Snapdragon flagship chip wants your AI agents to stay on-device
items.excerpt: Qualcomm detailed the NPU in the upcoming Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6, pitching a big jump in on-device model capacity. Qualcomm says the chip will run bigger models with ease so agents can work locally instead of round-tripping to the cloud.

items.headline: I finally tried XREAL's fully-baked Android XR glasses, and now I'm counting down to launch
items.excerpt: Hands-on with XREAL Aura, the first fully realized Android XR glasses, ahead of launch. XREAL has been teasing its first Android XR glasses for a long time, and the writer says they're genuinely worth the wait.

items.headline: The new W4 Plus is Timekettle's most capable AI interpreter earbuds yet
items.excerpt: Timekettle launched the W4 Plus at IFA 2026 with conversation memory that holds context across multi-turn talks, live summaries and 52 languages. Base model is $299 with an optional subscription, or $379 subscription-free.

items.headline: The HONOR Robot Phone feels like the first phone I'd actually buy for its weirdest feature
items.excerpt: Hands-on with HONOR's Robot Phone, whose motorized gimbal camera module turns the handset into a semi-autonomous camera operator. The oddest part of the design turns out to be the most convincing reason to buy it.

items.headline: Samsung's next AI glasses could finally put a screen in front of your eyes
items.excerpt: New supply-chain details point to Samsung's second-generation smart glasses adding a color display, moving the line from audio-plus-camera AI assistance toward a head-up visual interface.

items.headline: Apple Intelligence is getting usage limits, and here's what it means for you
items.excerpt: Apple is introducing usage caps on Apple Intelligence features as the new Siri AI rolls out, changing how much on-device and Private Cloud Compute work a user gets. The piece breaks down which features are metered and why.

items.headline: DJI launches new robot vacuums with an eye toward data privacy
items.excerpt: DJI's ROMO 2 line adds LiDAR-enabled mopping arms and millimeter-level floor-obstacle perception, plus local data handling after the first generation's hacking embarrassment. Suction adapts to what the robot sees on the floor.

items.headline: Roborock shows off a series of new vacuums at IFA 2026
items.excerpt: Roborock brought new robovacs with extendable wheels that climb small obstacles, plus a robomower and pool cleaner, to IFA 2026. The lineup leans on AI obstacle recognition to navigate cluttered homes.

items.headline: LG denies accusations of smart TVs continuously recording its users
items.excerpt: LG pushed back on claims that its AI-equipped smart TVs listen continuously, calling user privacy a fundamental principle of its products. The dispute lands as TV makers add always-available voice assistants.

items.headline: Dyson's new Nurovi robot vacuum has a UV light to show up invisible spills
items.excerpt: TechRadar saw Dyson's Nurovi robot vacuum in action and got the insider story from a Dyson designer. A UV light reveals invisible spills so the robot's vision system can target what a camera alone would miss.

items.headline: IFA 2026 'Best in Show' awards: our 25 favorite reveals at the Berlin tech expo
items.excerpt: TechRadar's pick of 25 standout IFA 2026 reveals, from somersaulting robots to modular solar batteries. A useful map of where AI hardware actually shipped at this year's Berlin show.

items.headline: The Roomba Duo is iRobot's attempt at rejecting the spec wars and trying something new
items.excerpt: iRobot's Roomba Duo carries a smaller companion robot it lowers with a mechanical arm to reach tight spaces, a form-factor bet instead of a suction-number bet. TechRadar frames it as iRobot rejecting the spec wars.

items.headline: FCC Grants First Robotics Ban Exemption to a Robomower Company
items.excerpt: The FCC granted its first exemption under the new robotics restrictions, clearing Swedish robot mower maker Husqvarna to sell new products in the US. It sets the first precedent for how autonomous home robots get to market.

items.headline: Google May Finally Release Laptops You Can't Just Ignore
items.excerpt: Leaks point to 'Googlebook' premium laptops built around Gemini, with features like Google facial authentication. Googlebooks are designed as higher-end machines whose special features are all about Gemini.

items.headline: Gizmodo's Best of IFA 2026 Awards: See the Winners
items.excerpt: Gizmodo's awards for the tech that most impressed at IFA 2026 in Berlin, heavy on AI-equipped home robots and wearables. A cross-category read on which AI devices were actually convincing on the show floor.

items.headline: Dex Language-Discovery Camera review: The rare AI gadget that keeps up with my non-stop 5-year-old
items.excerpt: A full review of Dex, a kid-facing AI camera that names objects aloud as children point it at the world. The reviewer says it pairs real-world curiosity with spoken vocabulary in a way that actually works.

items.headline: I've played for 100 hours on a VR headset lighter than my iPhone - Pimax Dream Air review
items.excerpt: The $1,999 Pimax Dream Air is an extremely light PC VR headset with an 8K display and wide field of view. The reviewer calls it an expensive breakthrough in comfort for long sessions.

items.headline: The 5 coolest pieces of wearable tech I demoed at IFA 2026 in Berlin
items.excerpt: Hands-on notes on five AI wearables from IFA 2026, from smarter smart rings to AI pendants pitched as a 'second memory'. Includes the Odyss N1 food-logging pendant and the camera-equipped iKairos.

items.headline: Apple confirms Siri AI launches in English this month, will add five languages in October
items.excerpt: Apple confirmed the rollout timeline for the rebuilt Siri AI, launching in English alongside iOS 27 before expanding to five more languages in October. It will not ship in China or the EU at launch.

items.headline: Three All-New 'Audio Intelligence' Features Arrive With Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4
items.excerpt: Apple announced Audio Intelligence, a set of Apple Intelligence features for Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4 that use the built-in microphone to catch missed moments in conversation and flag important sounds.

items.headline: At IFA 2026, computing chased the high and low ends - AI and budget machines left little for the rest of us
items.excerpt: A read on the IFA 2026 laptop floor: vendors split between chasing Apple's MacBook Neo at the top and cheap AI-branded machines at the bottom. The middle of the AI PC market barely got new hardware.

items.headline: Qualcomm's upcoming premium chip has Adreno 'Neural Fusion' GPU
items.excerpt: Qualcomm detailed Adreno 'Neural Fusion', a GPU block for its next flagship Snapdragon that fuses graphics and neural work on the same silicon. It follows the Oryon CPU reveal for the same chip.

items.headline: Quest's Meta Virtual Display Got A New Name, Input Forwarding & Mac Parity
items.excerpt: Meta's Quest virtual monitor feature was renamed and gained input forwarding, with the Mac version now matching Windows functionality. It makes a headset a more usable second display for desk work.

items.headline: TikTok Parent Reportedly Building AI Model to Rival Google's Genie for Real-Time Spatial Video
items.excerpt: ByteDance is reportedly readying an AI model dedicated to generating real-time spatial video, a direct answer to Google Genie. The company hopes it becomes a flywheel across its video and XR products.

items.headline: Colorful shows off AMD-powered gaming laptop with up to 128 GB RAM and Radeon 8060S iGPU
items.excerpt: Colorful's Lingchuang K16 pairs a Ryzen AI Max+ 395 Strix Halo APU with up to 128 GB of unified memory, the configuration that makes local large-model work practical on a laptop. No global launch is planned yet.
